result.note: Created 2026-11-02 by ClaudeCode at the operator's request during PR 87 (IMPL-UNITGREEN-001); not part of PR 87's scope.
description: Operator 2026-11-02, verbatim: "add medium todo: Create a validator for FR/TR/AC/UC/TODO links, identifying links to deleted items or simply missing items."

Scope: every link between functional requirements, technical requirements, acceptance criteria, use cases and TODOs (for example a TODO's functionalRequirements and technicalRequirements, FR to TR and TEST mappings, use case to FR links, AC ids cited by other records); the validator reports each link whose target is deleted (soft-deleted) or does not exist at all, naming the source record, the field and the target id.

Why: on 2026-11-02 TODO BUG-TRIAGE-139 still linked FR-MCP-USECASE-017 seven times after that FR was converted into TR-MCP-USECASE-019 and deleted on 2026-10-19; a requirement delete is a soft delete that any create with the same id revives, and the FR was restored and deleted again three times (triage-report-8928fd021e6b47c1945387935f0765d9; Workspace memory MEMORY-PROCESS-014). The same TODO held 71 link entries for 3 distinct ids.
Requirements first (profile 4.3): this is a new capability, so its FR, TR and acceptance criteria are captured through the plugin and a BDPv4 plan is approved before any implementation.

implementationTasks.task: Capture the FR, TR and acceptance criteria for the link validator through the requirements plugin route (deleted target, missing target, report shape, which link kinds are in scope)
Write the BDPv4 plan (contracts with scripted stores and wrong validators rejected, mock gate, implementation, bindings, gates) and get the operator's approval
Implement and validate per the approved plan, including its hostile validation

result.title: Validator for FR, TR, AC, UC and TODO links to deleted or missing items
